name: Least Pauraque
rangeDescription: Semiarid lowlands of hispaniola and gonâve island
description: A nocturnal inhabitant of open arid woodlands and thornscrub. Perches on ground from which it makes floppy and erratic flight upon its long wings in pursuit of insects.

name: Croaking Ground Dove
rangeDescription: Arid western ecuador, peru, and northern chile
description: Small, dirt-colored dove of desert lowlands, where it is often common in towns, parks, farmland, and semiopen areas in general. In pairs or small groups; feeds on the ground but often perches on wires.

name: Forster's Tern
rangeDescription: North america; winters southern usa to costa rica and greater antilles
description: Smaller than all the gulls, with thinner and more pointed bill. Distinguished from other terns by pale whitish wings and orange-based bill in summer, and isolated black ear patch in winter.

name: Lesser Kestrel
rangeDescription: Mediterranean basin to eastern china; winters to southern asia and southern africa
description: Elegant little falcon, often seen in groups. Males are unspotted above with a blue-gray head and similarly-colored patches on the upperwings; also note largely pale underwings.

name: Collared Nightjar
rangeDescription: Humid forest of eastern madagascar
description: Beautifully patterned cryptic nightjar. Found mainly inside of eastern and northern Madagascar rainforest, though very locally in dry forest.

name: Rufous-winged Ground-Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Southern venezuela, guyana, and northern brazil (roraima)
description: Large, terrestrial bird of lowland forest; unlike anything else in range. Appears all dark with paler belly; note long tail, heavy bill, and bare red skin around eye.

name: Slender Sheartail
rangeDescription: Highlands of southern mexico (chiapas) to western honduras and el salvador
description: Small hummingbird of scrubby forests and overgrown clearings in the mountains of Chiapas and south to southern Honduras. Feeds quietly at all levels and is easily overlooked.

name: Eastern Bonelli's Warbler
rangeDescription: Balkans, türkiye, and levant; winters to sudan
description: A small, pallid, long-winged leaf warbler. Separable from the closely related Western Bonelli's Warbler by range and vocalizations.

name: El Oro Parakeet
rangeDescription: Andean foothills of southwestern ecuador (el oro and azuay)
description: Rare and endangered parakeet endemic to foothill cloud forest in southwestern Ecuador. It is mostly green with red on forehead, shoulder, and undertail.

name: Star-spotted Nightjar
rangeDescription: Southern south sudan, ethiopia (and northern somalia?), and northern kenya
description: A medium-sized typical nightjar that is unusually plain, but with small white patches on the sides of the throat. Overall coloration varies from rufous to brown to gray.

name: Yellow-rumped Marshbird
rangeDescription: Eastern paraguay to southern brazil, uruguay, and northern argentina
description: Large blackbird with a long, thin bill found in marshes and wetlands. Mostly dark brown with a yellow belly, rump, and shoulders.

name: Subdesert Brush-Warbler
rangeDescription: Subdesert of southwestern madagascar
description: Medium-sized pale-brown bird with a long, spiky tail. Endemic to Madagascar, where it is found in southwestern spiny forest and scrub.

name: Kinglet Manakin
rangeDescription: Coastal southeastern brazil (bahia to rio de janeiro)
description: Chunky little, short-tailed bird of lowland and foothill forest. Male is distinctive with bright red crown and bold white stripes on reddish belly.

name: Black-lored Cisticola
rangeDescription: Highlands of northern malawi, northeastern zambia, and southern tanzania
description: Large, relatively colorful montane cisticola. Note the rufous cap and back of the neck, black patch between the bill and the eye, and the pale and black bands at the tip of the tail.

name: Great Dusky Swift
rangeDescription: Central and southern brazil to eastern paraguay and northeastern argentina
description: Large swift with uniform cold brown plumage with a pale face. Similar to Sooty Swift, but is larger and paler.

name: Lesser Antillean Euphonia
rangeDescription: Lesser antilles
description: Endemic to the Lesser Antilles. A brilliantly colored, tiny, and active species of dense woodlands where it feeds at middle to upper levels, primarily on mistletoe berries.

name: Yellow-necked Spurfowl
rangeDescription: Eritrea, ethiopia, djibouti, somalia, southeastern south sudan, northeastern uganda, kenya, and north-central tanzania
description: A large brown francolin with yellow bare skin on the throat and red bare skin around the eyes. The bill and legs are black.

name: Arabian Partridge
rangeDescription: Arid regions of southern arabian peninsula to yemen and oman
description: Handsome partridge of southern Arabia. Pale gray overall, with a tan patch on the neck, black-and-white slashes along the sides, and a complicated black-and-white facial pattern.

name: Variable Chachalaca
rangeDescription: Southern venezuela, the guianas, and northern amazonian brazil
description: Slender, long-tailed, chickenlike bird that is often seen in small groups. Grayish-brown overall with a warmer chestnut head.

name: White-cheeked Tern
rangeDescription: Islands and coasts of red sea and persian gulf to india
description: Sub-tropical tern; slightly smaller than Common Tern with a lighter and less powerful flight, as well as a longer-billed and shorter-legged profile. In all plumages, note the darker upperparts, including the rump and uppertail.
